src/agent_runtime/native/activities.py

Python · Tier A

Execute foreground activity batches while preserving admission and receipt ownership.

Responsibilities

  • Normalize model proposals, construct/preflight batches, isolate activity state, schedule workers and join their results.

Boundaries

  • Parallel policy supplies the run-wide limit; dependency_graph and resource_scheduler own their additional readiness/admission constraints. UI visualization is not a scheduler.

Lifecycle

  • A decision becomes a validated batch before workers enter execution. Joins publish ordered outcomes and promote foreground human waits; stop/recovery reconcile persisted records.

State

  • ActivityState overlays worker-local state; batch coordination uses locks and executors. Persisted batches retain resource claims and admission diagnostics alongside receipt identity; cancellation generations outlive a worker thread. Clarification-first graphs retain output_proposal on concrete Activities until work starts.

Security

  • Preflight runs before side effects and checks target/authority. Recovered uncertain work must not be treated as an unexecuted fresh command.

Collaborators

  • native/parallel_policy.py caps overlap; dependency_graph.py handles DAG batches; resource_scheduler.py coordinates claims; operations.py owns capability receipts.

Public surface

  • dispatch_batch and recover_batch integrate batch lifecycle with the model loop; create_batch, preflight and join_batch preserve validation/execution separation.

src/agent_runtime/native/attachment_access.py

Python · Tier A

Resolve authorized task attachments and verify their original bytes before explicit reads. descriptor/manifest expose bounded metadata and reader hints; resolve checks task lineage, live grants and archive parents; verified_bytes and decode_text enforce integrity and supported encodings. AttachmentError distinguishes denied references, missing bodies, changed sources and format-specific readers. Discovery grants no access and loads no document body; actual readers may load an entire bounded upload before paging.

src/agent_runtime/native/authority_control.py

Python · Tier A

Own deterministic user-authority checkpoints across native execution domains.

Responsibilities

Correlate, open, recover and project authority interactions; delegate decisions to the existing capability, permission, unsafe and Agent Check owners.

Boundaries

No inference, business dispatch, credential collection or policy evaluator.

Lifecycle

An accepted authority requirement opens a durable checkpoint before another model decision. Domain transactions apply decisions; ordinary owners resume execution.

State

Bounded, versioned envelopes live in the existing native checkpoint. Domain records retain exact payloads. No additional database or invocation journal is created.

Security

Envelopes contain identities and safe labels, never invocation arguments, credential values or unsafe authorization tokens. Cancellation and Pause take precedence.

Collaborators

Domain grant owners apply policy; native_store persists checkpoints; human_input and existing reply routes deliver decisions; lifecycle owners resume work.
